run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-16T21:34:31Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is explained by HTTP 500s on frontend-proxy's ingress and router-egress spans, which mirror failing checkout requests: frontend-proxy 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' error spans are HTTP 500 at about 5.0-5.3 s, frontend's errors are confined to /api/checkout and its gRPC client call to CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (code 13), checkout's PlaceOrder and HTTP POST spans fail at about 5.0 s with 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500', and shipping's /get-quote span returns 'Internal Server Error' because its child client span 'POST quote' ends in 'Timeout' after 5.000133 s. Cluster events show a Chaos Mesh Schedule named otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition (namespace chaos-mesh) spawning NetworkChaos objects once per minute starting 21:34:25Z - six seconds before the alert - each of which 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv' and 'otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w', then times up at :20 of the next minute and recovers. frontend-proxy's error-span increase jumps from 0-9 per 10 minutes to 81 at the window ending 21:36:31Z, reaches 588 by 21:44:31Z, and is still 96.8 per 2 minutes at 21:48:00Z. All otel-demo pods, including shipping and quote, are Running, ready and at restartCount 0, with no Evicted or OOMKilled events and no rollout at alert time, and quote's own spans carry no error status - so pod crashes, restarts and quote application errors are not supported as causes. Because the cause rests on events (the Schedule and NetworkChaos objects themselves could not be read with the permitted tools), the conclusion is partial.

claims.text: frontend-proxy (service_name="frontend-proxy") STATUS_CODE_ERROR span increase per 10 minutes was 0-9 through the window ending 21:34:31Z, then 81.05 at 21:36:31Z, 220.0 at 21:38:31Z, 353.7 at 21:40:31Z, 482.1 at 21:42:31Z, 588.4 at 21:44:31Z, 589.5 at 21:46:31Z, 532.6 at 21:48:31Z and 393.2 at 21:50:31Z, while its no-status (STATUS_CODE_UNSET) span volume stayed around 12,000-13,000 per 10 minutes.

frontend-proxy has only two span names, "ingress" and "router frontend egress", and both carry the errors: per 10 minutes the ERROR increase for "ingress" reached 295.8 and for "router frontend egress" 292.6 in the window ending 21:46:31Z, with both at 0 before the 21:36:31Z window.

frontend-proxy error spans are HTTP 500 with status tags error=true, http.status_code="500", otel.status_code="ERROR" and durations of 5.0-5.3 seconds (e.g. span 1103e97c99bbd21b 'ingress' 5328498 us and its child 4258824bbe4d9779 'router frontend egress' 5328426 us in trace 57075df3f14f46a92d8ea1cf5a6dbdd0).

frontend's error spans are confined to the checkout path - "POST /api/checkout", "POST", "executing api route (pages) /api/checkout" and "grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder" (rpc.grpc.status_code="13") each reached 290.5 per 10 minutes in the window ending 21:48:31Z, while frontend's other operations (GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, cart and ad gRPC calls, tcp.connect) stayed at 0.

checkout's error spans are "oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder" and "HTTP POST" (about 5.0 s, e.g. 5002788 us) with otel.status_description "shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500"; they reached 290.5 per 10 minutes in the window ending 21:48:31Z.

shipping's error spans are its server span "/get-quote" (otel.status_description "Internal Server Error", 5001391 us) and its child client span "POST quote" (otel.status_description "Timeout", 5001336 us); both reached 290.5 per 10 minutes in the window ending 21:48:31Z, and the load-generator's "POST" spans in the same traces also carry error=true and http.status_code="500".

Chaos Mesh events show one Schedule, involvedObject.kind "Schedule", name "otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition", namespace chaos-mesh (20 Schedule events: Spawned/Updated), plus ten NetworkChaos objects (otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition-9xnx8, -nz4lm, -85v74, -rw58g, -lwvxl, -769cj, -q7g8w, -fsflv, -5ks6l, -5czjs).

Each NetworkChaos cycle emits "Experiment has started", "Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv" and "Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w" at :25 of a minute, then "Time up according to the duration" and "Successfully recover chaos" for both pods at :20 of the next minute; the first cycle ran at 21:34:25Z-21:35:20Z and cycles repeated every minute through the cycle started 21:43:25Z.

PodNetworkChaos objects named "quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w" and "shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv" in namespace otel-demo were Updated at each apply and each recovery, and the cluster-wide event grouping for this window contains 38 PodNetworkChaos Updated events in otel-demo.

quote's own spans (POST /getquote, calculate-quote, {closure}) carry only STATUS_CODE_UNSET - no ERROR status, with no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series present for quote - and its 10-minute span volume fell from 947.7-1061.1 (windows ending 21:29:31Z-21:44:31Z) to 176.8 and 115.7; email's fell from about 1419 to 235.8 and 154.3 over the same windows.

All 21 otel-demo pods, including frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-wvxht, frontend-675fd7b5c5-kgxrg, checkout-5dccddf8bb-pd7qk, shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv and quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w, are Running with ready=true and restartCount 0; the frontend, checkout, shipping and quote ReplicaSets were created 20:57:42Z, before the alert.

checkout's container logs show successful "order confirmation email sent to ..." bursts at 21:40:20-22, 21:41:20-25, 21:42:20-21, 21:43:20-21 and 21:44:20-21 - immediately after each chaos cycle's TimeUp at :20 of the minute - and the returned checkout lines in that window are these success messages, not error lines.

shipping's Deployment container env sets QUOTE_ADDR=http://quote:8080; the quote Deployment runs image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-quote (container quote, port 8080) and the email Deployment runs image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-email (container email, port 8080).

The only non-otel-demo activity in the cluster-wide event grouping was in namespace data-recorders (Deployment ScalingReplicaSet 1, Job SuccessfulCreate 4, Job Completed 3, PersistentVolumeClaim Provisioning/ProvisioningSucceeded/WaitForFirstConsumer 5 each, StatefulSet SuccessfulCreate 4, ReplicaSet SuccessfulCreate 1); no Evicted, OOMKilling, BackOff, Failed or Unhealthy pod events appear in the grouped event list for otel-demo.

The Schedule otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition (namespace chaos-mesh), which spawns the per-minute NetworkChaos experiments applied to pods shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv and quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w, is the origin of the incident: the induced network fault on those two pods makes shipping's HTTP client call "POST quote" time out at 5.0 s, shipping returns 500 on /get-quote, checkout's PlaceOrder fails with gRPC code 13, frontend returns 500 on POST /api/checkout, and frontend-proxy's ingress returns 500 - the error stream the RequestErrorRate alert measures. The first chaos cycle at 21:34:25Z precedes the alert time 21:34:31Z by six seconds, and the 5.0 s client timeouts together with quote receiving fewer spans but reporting no errors of its own fit a blocked path between shipping and quote.

The name of the offending Schedule (otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition) and checkout's error text "failed POST to email service" both reference email, while the events show the chaos applied to the shipping and quote pods and shipping's failing client span is "POST quote"; this suggests the experiment's name and message wording and its actual selected targets diverge, rather than email being the blocked dependency. Email's own span volume fell (about 1419 to 154 per 10 minutes) with no error status on any returned email series, which is consistent with checkout being impacted on the shipping/quote path, not with email failing.

quote's own server spans POST /getquote, calculate-quote and {closure} carry only STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series exists for service_name="quote", so there is no observed application failure inside quote; the failure signature is a caller-side 5 s timeout recorded in shipping's "POST quote" client span.

frontend-proxy's own error spans have essentially the same duration as the calls they wrap (e.g. ingress 5009721 us vs its child router-egress 5009616 us vs frontend's POST 5009518 us), and frontend's errors appear only on the /api/checkout route, so the error originates upstream of frontend-proxy rather than in frontend-proxy itself.

Pod crash, OOM or restart of shipping or quote is rejected: all otel-demo pods are Running, ready and at restartCount 0, the ReplicaSets date from 20:57:42Z, and the grouped cluster events contain no Evicted, OOMKilling, BackOff, Failed or Unhealthy events for otel-demo pods.

A fault-injection feature flag is rejected as this cause: every flag in ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config demo.flagd.json (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) has defaultVariant "off".

gaps: The Chaos Mesh API objects could not be read: NetworkChaos, PodNetworkChaos and Schedule are not kinds the permitted Kubernetes tools accept, so the experiment's selector, direction, action (partition vs delay/loss) and duration setting are unverified; the cause rests on events plus the observed 5 s timeouts, which is why the conclusion is partial.

The cluster event data returned no events newer than 21:43:53Z, while frontend-proxy error spans were still being recorded at 21:48:00Z (2-minute increase 96.8, shipping 95.3); whether the Schedule still exists and keeps spawning NetworkChaos cycles after 21:43:53Z is unknown.

An instant query of sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])) at 2026-11-16T21:51:56Z returned status no_data, so the error rate at that exact instant is unknown; the last usable range samples were 21:50:31Z (393.2 error spans per 10 minutes for frontend-proxy) and 21:48:00Z (96.8 per 2 minutes).

list_prometheus_rules with rule_name "RequestErrorRate" returned status no_data, so the alert's exact PromQL expression, threshold and evaluation window could not be verified; the alert annotation value 0.6444444444444444 was not independently reproduced (observed 393.2 error spans per 600 s is about 0.655 per second, similar in magnitude but not proven to be the same expression).

checkout's error text says "failed POST to email service" while shipping's env is QUOTE_ADDR=http://quote:8080 and shipping's failing client span is named "POST quote"; the application source and image contents were not readable, so where that message string is produced and whether an email call was involved is unverified.

Log queries for shipping (filter expected|email|Failed|error) and quote (filter err|fail|exception|timeout) both returned status no_data with zero matching lines, and their readable streams ended at 21:44:30Z / 21:44:20Z; log absence is not proof that no error was logged, so quote's and shipping's application logs are a stated gap rather than a finding.

Only a biased trace sample was available: traces_search for frontend-proxy reported incomplete because the backend returned as many traces as requested, the read slice of the error-tag search was truncated (12 of 185 rows), and the error-tag search for frontend-proxy exceeded the view limit; the exact per-request span fan-out and the complete set of affected operations are therefore not exhaustively verified.
next_steps: Advisory: inspect and, if the experiment is not intentional, suspend or delete the Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition in namespace chaos-mesh so the per-minute shipping/quote network fault stops, then confirm shipping's 'POST quote' timeouts and frontend-proxy ingress 500s cease.

Advisory: review the Schedule/NetworkChaos manifest, since its name references email and checkout while the applied targets are the shipping and quote pods, and align the selector with the intended experiment.
Advisory: confirm the alert expression for RequestErrorRate and re-read the frontend-proxy error rate after the chaos schedule is removed to verify recovery rather than assume it.
Advisory: check shipping's HTTP client timeout configuration, since the 5 s client timeout surfaces as an upstream 500 chain reaching frontend-proxy.
